roadmap.title: Clear 5-Day SSB (Services Selection Board) Interview

roadmap.title: Pass Rigorous Military Medical Board Exam

roadmap.title: Complete 1 Year Advanced Training at IMA / AFA / INA
roadmap.desc: Master advanced military tactics, naval navigation, or supersonic flight maneuvers.

roadmap.title: Get Commissioned as an Officer in Armed Forces
